description: Adds a marker to the specified sequence for navigation or notes. The sequence does not have to be the active one.

color.description: Marker colour — a name (green, red, purple, orange, yellow, white, blue, cyan) or an index 0-7. Defaults to green.

comment.description: Optional comment or description for the marker

duration.description: Duration in seconds for a span marker (0 for point marker)

sequenceId.description: The sequence ID (GUID) to add the marker to, as returned in the "id" field by list_sequences or get_active_sequence. Defaults to the active sequence.

time.description: The time in seconds where the marker should be placed

name: add_marker
